search_text: published ZDI-20-684 ZDI-CAN-10007 NEC ESMPRO Manager RMI Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-06-01 CVE-2020-10917 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-10917 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['NEC'] ['ESMPRO Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NEC ESMPRO Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the RMI service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in version 11.0.5 ['2020-01-16 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2020-06-01 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Sivathmican Sivakumaran of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-20-684/
title: NEC ESMPRO Manager RMI Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NEC ESMPRO Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the RMI service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
